_README: Every platform names the same service differently. This map collapses those variants onto ONE canonical tile, so a single graphic serves Apple TV, Android TV, Samsung and anything added later. Left = slug of the name the device reports; right = the tile file used. Add a variant here rather than duplicating a PNG. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_apple_tv: names exactly as tvOS reports them
_android_tv: names as leanback apps report them
